name: Brutish Cuirass

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class .

effects.name: Strength
effects.tooltip: Strength +6 : This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Strength.

effects.name: Fortitude Save
effects.tooltip: Fortitude Save +6 : This item gives a +6 Resistance bonus to your Fortitude saves.

effects.name: Staggering Blow
effects.tooltip: Staggering Blow : This item is enchanted to make your attacks send enemies reeling. When you roll a 20 on an attack with a melee weapon you will knock the target down unless it makes a DC 17 Balance check.

effects.name: Acid Resistance
effects.tooltip: Acid Resistance +24 : Passive: +24 Enhancement bonus to your Acid Resistance.

effects.name: Adamantine
effects.tooltip: Adamantine : Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.

flavor_text: This suit of armor seems to have been crafted for Droaam troops to enhance their aggressive tendencies. It invests the wearer's attacks with great fervor, causing them to stun enemies occasionally.
